blocks.content: On 14 August 2026, the Government of India announced 1,057 Gallantry and Service Medals for personnel in the police, fire services, Home Guard and Civil Defence, and correctional services. The awards were announced on the eve of the 80th Independence Day under the medal system administered by the Ministry of Home Affairs.

items: The Ministry of Home Affairs announces police medals every year on the eve of Independence Day.
The Indian medal system for police and fire services includes Gallantry Medal, President’s Medal for Distinguished Service, and Medal for Meritorious Service.
The Central Bureau of Investigation is a central investigative agency under the Government of India.
Left Wing Extremism-affected areas are among the main operational zones for gallantry awards in India.
